items.source: This contract is not used directly in applications but a custom implementation can be plugged in through the MockRestServiceServer builder.
items.translation: 该合约不会直接在应用程序中使用，但可以通过 `MockRestServiceServer` 构建器plugged进行自定义实现。

items.source: AssertionError - when some expectations were not met
items.translation: AssertionError - 当某些预期未满足时

items.source: requestMatcher - a request expectation
items.translation: requestMatcher - 一个请求期望

items.source: This is a delegate for MockRestServiceServer.expect(ExpectedCount, RequestMatcher).
items.translation: 这是 `MockRestServiceServer.expect(ExpectedCount, RequestMatcher)` 的一个委托。

items.source: This is a delegate for MockRestServiceServer.verify().
items.translation: 这是 MockRestServiceServer.verify() 的委托。

items.source: This is a delegate for MockRestServiceServer.reset().
items.translation: 这是MockRestServiceServer.reset()的委托。

items.source: This is used in MockRestServiceServer against actual requests.
items.translation: 这用于在 `MockRestServiceServer` 中针对实际请求。

items.source: Variant of verify() that waits for up to the specified time for all expectations to be fulfilled.
items.translation: `verify()` 的变体，等待指定的最长时间以完成所有期望。

items.source: Variant of verify() that waits for up to the specified time for all expectations to be fulfilled. This can be useful for tests that involve asynchronous requests.
items.translation: `verify()` 的变体，它会等待指定的时间，直到所有期望得到满足。这对于涉及异步请求的测试非常有用。

items.source: Set up a new request expectation.
items.translation: 设置新的请求期望。

items.source: Reset the internal state removing all expectations and recorded requests.
items.translation: 重置内部状态，移除所有期望和已记录的请求。

items.source: Validate the given actual request against the declared expectations.
items.translation: 验证给定的实际请求是否符合声明的预期。

items.source: Verify that all expectations have been met.
items.translation: 验证所有预期是否已满足。

items.source: AssertionError - if not all expectations are met
items.translation: AssertionError - 如果未满足所有预期

items.source: AssertionError - if not all expectations are met by the specified timeout, or if any expectation fails at any time before that.
items.translation: AssertionError - 如果未能在指定的超时时间内满足所有期望，或者在此之前的任何时间期望失败。

items.source: IOException - in case of any validation errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 如果出现任何验证错误

items.source: timeout - how long to wait for all expectations to be met
items.translation: timeout - 等待所有期望得到满足的时间长度

items.source: request - the request
items.translation: request - 请求

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev

items.source: for setting up further expectations and define a response
items.translation: 用于设定进一步的期望并定义响应。

items.source: the response to return if the request was validated.
items.translation: 如果请求经过验证，则返回的响应。
